'''''Travels with Gormaanda: Cooking in the Core''''' was a [[Book/Legends|book]] published by the famous [[The galaxy/Legends|intergalactic]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Gormaanda/Legends|Gormaanda]]. In the tome, she dispensed such sage advice as when to tip servers. One of the more useful tips it provided was "Don't forget to tip your [[FA-5 valet droid/Legends|FA]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] while on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. They are programmed to blacklist the stingy".<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Droids">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
